name: Multi-Agent Collaboration
description: Multiple specialized agents coordinate through defined communication structures (hierarchical, peer-to-peer, hybrid) to solve problems beyond the capability of any single agent. Each agent owns a role and shares state, plans, or results via message passing or shared memory.
when_to_use: Tasks span multiple domains requiring specialized expertise
Single-agent context windows or capability ceilings are exceeded
Parallel exploration of solution space is beneficial
Robustness through redundancy and role specialization is required
use_cases: Research workflows combining search, summarization and writing agents
Software engineering crews (CrewAI, AutoGen) with planner/coder/reviewer roles
Customer support routing across specialized bots
Multi-step data pipelines orchestrated by autonomous agents

typescript.description: Minimal orchestrator broadcasting subtasks to role-specialized agents.
